headline: Bitcoin slides for a fifth straight day as Nvidia's 10% crash deepens crypto's risk-off mood
summary: A sharp drop in Nvidia shares — triggered by CEO Jensen Huang's resignation — amplified an already fragile crypto market, pushing Bitcoin down 2.73% to $71,545 and extending a five-day streak of ETF outflows. Ethereum fell 2.60%, Solana dropped 3.40%, and the Fear & Greed Index sits at 28, deep in fear territory. The day's bigger stories are forward-looking: Ethereum is fast-tracking quantum-resistant cryptography, and the DTCC announced plans to bring tokenized securities to Solana by 2027.

winners.name: Gram (prev. Toncoin)
winners.catalyst: Gram posted the day's top gain of +2.92% with no identifiable news catalyst — the move stood out against broad market weakness, suggesting idiosyncratic buying or short covering.

losers.name: Rain
losers.catalyst: Rain fell 11.34% with no specific catalyst identified — the drop came against a backdrop of broad market weakness and a Fear & Greed Index of 28, amplifying selling pressure on smaller assets.

whyItMoved: Two forces hit crypto simultaneously today. The more immediate was Nvidia: CEO Jensen Huang's resignation sent Nvidia shares down 10%, and because Nvidia has become a proxy for AI and tech risk appetite broadly, the selloff spilled into Bitcoin and other risk assets. Bitcoin's 2.73% decline extended its losing streak to five consecutive sessions — and each of those sessions has seen net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, meaning institutional fund buyers have been net sellers all week. That combination of equity-market contagion and sustained ETF redemption pressure kept the market firmly in fear territory; the Fear & Greed Index reads 28, a level associated with defensive positioning rather than fresh buying. Monero took the hardest hit among the top 15, falling 6.45%, while BNB dropped 4.09% and Dogecoin fell 4.40% — all consistent with a broad risk-off session rather than any asset-specific news. Ethereum slipped 2.60% to just under $2,000, a psychologically watched level. The one notable exception in the top 15 was Figure Heloc, which gained 2.56%, though no specific catalyst was identified for that move.
worthKnowing: Ethereum core researchers have deprioritized faster block times in order to accelerate post-quantum cryptography upgrades, targeting a 2027 deployment as concerns grow about AI-driven advances in quantum computing.

The DTCC — the US clearinghouse that settles the vast majority of American securities trades — announced plans to deploy tokenized securities infrastructure on Solana by the second half of 2027, a significant institutional endorsement for the network.
India's Enforcement Directorate raided domestic crypto exchanges CoinDCX and Delta over suspected illegal cross-border transactions, escalating regulatory pressure on the country's crypto sector.
A $100 million liquidity facility backed by BlackRock's BUIDL tokenized fund went live through a Securitize and Ethena partnership, marking a notable step in institutional DeFi integration.
